description.value: This study compared the neural substrates of intentional emotion regulation through cognitive reappraisal and incidental emotion regulation through affect labeling in healthy participants using fMRI, focusing on amygdala activation and IFG-amygdala connectivity.

spans.text: Here, we compared amygdala and IFG activation in these participants, with the expectation of revealing overlap in the neural substrates recruited by each task.
